# Bergert & Nosofsky (2007) cue-based pairwise choice

Bergert, F. B., & Nosofsky, R. M. (2007). A response-time approach to comparing generalized rational and take-the-best models of decision making. *Journal of Experimental Psychology: Learning, Memory, and Cognition*, 33, 107–129.

Eight alternatives × six binary cues, 40 pairwise problems, 61 people. This is the teaching extract used in *Bayesian Cognitive Modeling*.

## Files

- `trials.csv` — 2,440 rows
- `alternatives.csv` — cue pattern for each alternative
- `problems.csv` — which two alternatives appear
- `cueValidities.csv` — validity and log-odds weight

`choice` uses the original coding (0 vs 1 selects one of the two alternatives in `problems.csv`).
